application-shell.rationale: Compose the application shell from Workbench, SplitView, NavStack, or TabNavigator instead of a Web Awesome page.

application-tabs.rationale: Render TabBar (or SegmentedControl for a view switch) instead of composing Web Awesome tabs directly.

command-menu.rationale: Render PopupMenu, Kerf's native command menu; use Select when choosing a value.

embedded-media.rationale: Keep media behavior application-owned: place a native img, video, or iframe in a ContentItem. Record a narrow KUI-L301 profile exception only when a concrete product requirement needs this Web Awesome element.

exclusive-choice.rationale: Render SegmentedControl for one-of-N choices instead of a Web Awesome button group.

hierarchy-navigation.rationale: Present hierarchy as List rows (or NavStack drill-in levels). Record a narrow KUI-L301 profile exception only when the product requires tree behavior.

icon.rationale: Render LucideIcon; Web Awesome icons are not part of the Kerf icon contract.

resizable-pane.rationale: Render ResizableRegion for application panes instead of a Web Awesome split panel.

value-selection.rationale: Render Select, which replaces wa-select and wa-option with Kerf's own popup, form, and spacing contract.

action-button.rationale: Render Button, a native button with Kerf tones and sizes, icon-only with ariaLabel, or a toggle with pressed.

text-entry.rationale: Render TextField, a native input or textarea with Kerf label, hint, error, clear, and count anatomy.

boolean-option.rationale: Render Checkbox, a native checkbox drawn as a Kerf box.

exclusive-option.rationale: Render RadioGroup, a native radio group with a choices array.

immediate-setting.rationale: Render Switch, a native switch-role checkbox for a setting that applies immediately.

modal-dialog.rationale: Render DialogSurface, a native dialog opened with openDialog and closed with closeDialog; use its side-sheet or bottom-sheet presentation instead of a Web Awesome drawer.

status-badge.rationale: Render Badge for compact status, count, or category metadata.

removable-tag.rationale: Render Chip for a tag, removable or not.

loading-placeholder.rationale: Render Skeleton for a loading placeholder.

anchored-surface.rationale: Render AnchoredSurface for anchored interactive help or popup content; position other elements with kerfjs/overlay's positionAnchored.

content-container.rationale: Contain related content in a ContentItem (appearance="surface" for a raised card) or a SunkenPanel instead of a Web Awesome card.

inline-status.rationale: Render StateBanner for persistent inline status instead of a Web Awesome callout.

fetched-content.rationale: Fetch remote content with resource() from kerfjs/async and render it as Kerf content inside a ContentItem; never inject fetched markup.

scroll-region.rationale: Let a Pane own vertical scrolling with scroll edges, or use ColumnTrack for a horizontal track, instead of a Web Awesome scroller.

transient-notification.rationale: Call toast() from kerfjs/overlay with @kerfjs/ui/overlay-toast.css imported instead of a Web Awesome toast stack.

hover-explanation.rationale: Call tooltip() from kerfjs/overlay with @kerfjs/ui/overlay-tooltip.css imported instead of a Web Awesome tooltip; icon-only Kerf controls already get help tags.

show-hide-content.rationale: Use the Kerf Disclosure (a native details element) for show-and-hide content, and Disclosures sharing a name for an accordion.

progress-indicator.rationale: Use the Kerf ProgressBar, a native progress element with a label row, tones, and an indeterminate sweep.

compact-progress.rationale: Use the Kerf ProgressRing where a bar does not fit, inline in text, a row, or a toolbar.

range-value.rationale: Use the Kerf Slider, a native range input drawn as a track, fill, and thumb, with wireSliders for its live readout.

tag-list.rationale: Use the Kerf TagField, SearchField's token editor as a form field with a hidden input per tag, wired by wireTagFields.
